svg.title: PASSIVES, SEMICONDUCTORS AND MAGNETICS
svg.desc: SOURCE-REFERENCED CANDIDATES

svg.title: Resistor — axial physical
svg.desc: Side view of an illustrative axial-leaded resistor with end caps and uncolored band boundaries. No value, tolerance or dimensions are specified.

svg.title: Resistor — rectangular schematic
svg.desc: A two-terminal rectangular resistor mark. The stubs are circuit connections, without endpoint rings.

svg.title: Polarized radial capacitor — proposed drafting variant
svg.desc: Generic cylindrical polarized radial capacitor in an oblique exterior view. Negative sleeve stripe at left with three minus marks; two parallel leads emerge below, with positive right lead longer. No rating or wiring instruction.

svg.title: Capacitor — unpolarized schematic
svg.desc: A two-terminal capacitor with equal straight plates and no indicated polarity.

svg.title: Inductor — coil physical
svg.desc: Illustrative side view of an exposed winding on a bobbin with two axial leads. The winding and axial lead arrangement combine separate visual references and do not depict a specific product.

svg.title: Inductor — schematic
svg.desc: A two-terminal coil schematic without a core material designation.

svg.title: Axial diode — proposed drafting variant
svg.desc: Generic axial diode in an oblique exterior view, with two leads and a single filled band near the right end. The band is illustrative, not wiring instruction.

svg.title: Diode — rectifier schematic
svg.desc: A rectifier diode mark, with anode on the left and cathode bar on the right.

svg.title: PASSIVES, SEMICONDUCTORS AND MAGNETICS
svg.desc: SOURCE-REFERENCED CANDIDATES

svg.title: Three-lead package — proposed drafting variant
svg.desc: Generic TO-92-like package with a flat face, bevel boundaries, a shallow top plane and three separate parallel leads. No pinout or semiconductor type is assigned.

svg.title: Transistor — NPN schematic
svg.desc: An NPN bipolar transistor with base at left, collector at upper right, and emitter at lower right with outward arrow.

svg.title: Eight-lead package — proposed drafting variant
svg.desc: Generic dual-inline package in an oblique top view with one end notch and four separate lead positions on each side. Pin functions and package dimensions are not assigned.

svg.title: Integrated circuit — functional block schematic
svg.desc: An unspecified four-terminal integrated-circuit block. The four terminal functions are not named.

svg.title: Core-type transformer — proposed drafting variant
svg.desc: A simplified closed core with two separate winding groups on opposite limbs and four external lead stubs. The shallow core face is explanatory; no rating, winding connection or turns ratio is assigned.

svg.title: Transformer — two-winding schematic
svg.desc: Two separate windings coupled by a magnetic core, with four connection stubs. Neither polarity dots nor a turns ratio are specified.

svg.title: Generator — generic schematic
svg.desc: A generic generator represented by G inside a circle, with two electrical connection stubs. Current type and phase are unspecified.

svg.title: Motor — generic schematic
svg.desc: A generic motor represented by M inside a circle, with two electrical connection stubs. Current type and phase are unspecified.

svg.title: SWITCHING, PROTECTION AND CONNECTIONS
svg.desc: SOURCE-REFERENCED CANDIDATES

svg.title: Switch — normally open schematic
svg.desc: An open single-pole switch with a tilted blade and two contact points. Local schematic example; no device or formal standard conformity is asserted.

svg.title: Relay — coil and normally open contact
svg.desc: A relay coil and a separate normally open contact are linked by a dashed mechanical association. Local schematic example; the coil and contact remain electrically separate. No contact rating or power supply is specified.

svg.title: Contactor — proposed drafting variant
svg.desc: Generic contactor block in an oblique front view with two rows of three slotted screw-access positions and a central face. No terminal functions, contact state or rating are assigned.

svg.title: Fuse — schematic
svg.desc: A fuse represented by a rectangle with a conductor through it. Local schematic example; no fuse rating or formal standard conformity is asserted.

svg.title: Circuit breaker — enclosed open contact
svg.desc: An interface pictogram combines a breaker-like enclosure and actuator with a visibly open internal contact. A hybrid pictogram, not an observed device cutaway, protective-device schematic or trip mechanism.

svg.title: Disconnect — open isolator schematic
svg.desc: An open isolating-switch contact with a diagonal blade and marked fixed contact. Adapted from a switch-disconnector example; the mark does not establish isolation performance or formal conformity.

svg.title: Ground — signal reference
svg.desc: A downward open triangle with one upper lead represents a local signal reference. The symbol does not establish protective bonding or an earth connection; its convention depends on the drawing legend.

svg.title: Protective earth — reference mark
svg.desc: A circled three-bar protective-earth reference mark with one upper lead. The graphic does not prove bonding, installation, formal conformity or safety qualification.

svg.title: SWITCHING, PROTECTION AND CONNECTIONS
svg.desc: SOURCE-REFERENCED CANDIDATES

svg.title: Mated connector — proposed drafting variant
svg.desc: Generic mated cylindrical connector with a central coupling collar and two cable-edge strokes at each end. No contact count, family, pinout, fit or dimension is assigned.

svg.title: Connector — unmated two-contact schematic
svg.desc: Two independent pairs of plug and socket contacts shown separated by visible gaps. Unmated schematic example; no electrical connection crosses either gap and no polarity or mating standard is specified.

svg.title: Screw terminal — proposed drafting variant
svg.desc: A generic single slotted screw-clamp position on the top face of a shallow terminal block. No wire size, internal construction or rating is assigned.

svg.title: Terminal — schematic
svg.desc: A single terminal represented by a hollow ring between two conductor stubs. Local adaptation of the terminal-circle convention, distinct from the palette junction dot. The circle alone does not establish a particular terminal type or formal conformity.

svg.title: Two-blade plug — proposed drafting variant
svg.desc: Generic two-blade plug with a flanged molded body, shallow top face and cable neck. Blade count and cable edges match the baseline; no fit, voltage, rating or standard conformity is claimed.

svg.title: Plug — pin contacts schematic
svg.desc: Two separate schematic plug-side pins represented by filled contact tips and plain leads. No contact polarity, physical housing or mating standard is specified.

svg.title: Two-contact socket — proposed drafting variant
svg.desc: A generic shallow socket housing with two filled rectangular slots in the front mating face, consistent with the corresponding two-blade plug. No actual mating fit, voltage, rating or standard conformity.

svg.title: Socket — receptacle contacts schematic
svg.desc: Two separate schematic socket-side contacts represented by curves with plain leads. No contact polarity or mating standard is specified.

svg.title: POWER, INSTRUMENTATION AND CONTROL
svg.desc: SOURCE-REFERENCED CANDIDATES

svg.title: Cylindrical cell — proposed drafting variant
svg.desc: Generic cylindrical cell in an oblique exterior view; minus at left, plus and protruding positive terminal at right. No cell chemistry, capacity, voltage, or size is assigned.

svg.title: Battery — multi-cell schematic
svg.desc: A two-cell battery, with long plates on the left of each pair and the positive terminal on the left. Local schematic mark; no voltage, chemistry or formal-standard conformity is asserted.

svg.title: Power supply — AC to DC block
svg.desc: A functional block representing an AC-input to DC-output power supply. Functional pictogram only; arrows denote conversion direction and are not terminals. No ratings, waveform, isolation or circuit topology is specified.

svg.title: Converter — DC to AC inverter block
svg.desc: A functional block representing a DC-input to AC-output converter. Functional pictogram only; arrows denote conversion direction and are not terminals. No phase count, ratings, waveform, isolation or circuit topology is specified.

svg.title: Sensor — input to electrical output
svg.desc: A sensor block receiving a physical stimulus and presenting two electrical output contacts. Generic input-to-electrical-output pictogram; the stimulus, quantity, response and pin polarity are unspecified. It does not identify a particular sensor.

svg.title: Transducer — conversion block
svg.desc: A functional block transforming an input quantity x into an output quantity y. Generic conversion pictogram with unspecified x and y domains and transfer function; this generalizes a measurement-transducer reference.

svg.title: Instrumentation — voltmeter schematic
svg.desc: A voltmeter represented by a V inside a circle, with two measuring terminals. Local schematic mark; no reading, range, accuracy or formal-standard conformity is asserted.

svg.title: AND gate — schematic
svg.desc: An AND logic gate with two inputs and one output. A simplified logic mark; no formal-standard conformity or particular device is asserted.

svg.title: OR gate — schematic
svg.desc: An OR logic gate with two inputs and one output. A simplified logic mark; no formal-standard conformity or particular device is asserted.

svg.title: NOT gate — schematic
svg.desc: A NOT logic gate with one input and one inverted output. A simplified logic mark; the output bubble means inversion. No formal-standard conformity or particular device is asserted.

svg.title: NAND gate — schematic
svg.desc: A NAND logic gate with two inputs and one inverted output. A simplified logic mark; the output bubble means inversion. No formal-standard conformity or particular device is asserted.

svg.title: Basic control circuit — open switch and coil rung
svg.desc: A normally open switch in series with a coil on a two-terminal control rung. Illustrative incomplete rung fragment: source, return, voltage, latching branch and controlled contacts are not shown. It is not a wiring or safety design.

svg.title: MECHANICAL AND STRUCTURAL
svg.desc: DRAWING TYPES IDENTIFIED WITH EACH ITEM
svg.text: DRAWING TYPES IDENTIFIED WITH EACH ITEM

svg.title: Gear — physical form
svg.desc: Face view of a toothed wheel with hub and bore. Teeth are conventionalized and not a manufacturable involute, specification or gear ratio.

svg.title: Pulley
svg.desc: Face view of a grooved pulley with a rope tangent to its rim. Shaft support and rope load are omitted.

svg.title: Belt drive
svg.desc: A continuous belt wraps two wheel rims. Equal drawn wheel sizes do not specify a drive ratio, belt tension or performance.

svg.title: Chain drive — proposed explanatory variant
svg.desc: Two toothed wheels and a closed loop of evenly pitched rollers in a face-view diagram. Simplified teeth, links and pitch are not manufacturing specifications.

svg.title: Cam and follower
svg.desc: An eccentric cam profile contacts a roller follower. The drawn profile does not define lift, timing or a validated contact analysis.

svg.title: Lever
svg.desc: A straight lever rests on a pivot support. No load, fulcrum friction or lever ratio is specified.

svg.title: Four-bar linkage
svg.desc: Three connected links join two grounded pivot points, forming a four-bar linkage. Drawn geometry is illustrative; mobility, stiffness and motion are not solved.

svg.title: Rolling-element bearing
svg.desc: Concentric races and six balls depict a bearing in face view. Simplified geometry does not specify the bearing type, load rating or clearances.

svg.title: Compression spring — proposed wire-boundary view
svg.desc: Generic open-ended helical compression spring with a single continuous center path and visible wire boundaries. The near strand occludes the far strand at each projected crossing. Four turns and the depicted width are illustrative. The projected ribbon is not an exact three-dimensional round-wire silhouette or a dimensional specification.

svg.title: Stepped shaft
svg.desc: A longitudinal outline shows a stepped shaft and its axis. Diameters, lengths and surface requirements are unspecified.

svg.title: Flanged shaft coupling — parallel oblique exterior
svg.desc: Two coaxial shaft ends enter opposed hubs and flanges. The flanges meet at a visible seam. Two bolt heads on the near flange face indicate the fastened joint. Bolt count, shaft fit, dimensions and capacity are not specified.

svg.title: Pinned lap joint — proposed drafting variant
svg.desc: Two overlapping link ends sit on distinct near and far planes and share a single pin. Only the connection is shown; joint freedoms, dimensions, retention and load capacity are unspecified.

svg.title: Pulley and spring variations
svg.desc: SAVED VARIATIONS / 35 MM FRAMES AT 100% PRINT SCALE
svg.text: SAVED VARIATIONS / 35 MM FRAMES AT 100% PRINT SCALE
PULLEY / FACE AND SHALLOW OBLIQUE VIEWS

svg.title: Pulley
svg.desc: Face view of a grooved pulley with a rope tangent to its rim. Shaft support and rope load are omitted.

svg.title: Pulley A — visible rope path
svg.desc: Diagrammatic face view of one wheel, a continuous rope with two downward tails, and the axle center. The wheel rim is omitted under the coincident upper rope arc so the path remains distinct. The rope groove and load are not physically specified.

svg.title: Pulley B — near flange hides wrap
svg.desc: Face view of a generic flanged wheel. A single continuous rope is drawn behind the opaque near flange so its upper wrap is concealed and two free tails emerge below the wheel. This is a generic visibility interpretation, not the exact product drawing.

svg.title: Pulley C — shallow oblique view
svg.desc: Generic shallow parallel-oblique view. Two equal-height end ellipses share the same axle; the rope follows an intermediate projected ellipse with two free tails and is partially hidden by the opaque near face. The body is simplified and does not specify an actual groove cross-section or manufacturer.

svg.title: Compression spring — proposed wire-boundary view
svg.desc: Generic open-ended helical compression spring with a single continuous center path and visible wire boundaries. The near strand occludes the far strand at each projected crossing. Four turns and the depicted width are illustrative. The projected ribbon is not an exact three-dimensional round-wire silhouette or a dimensional specification.

svg.title: Spring A — four-turn wire boundary
svg.desc: Generic open-ended projected compression helix with 4 illustrative turns. A constant-width projected wire boundary with near-over-far crossing order; it is not an exact swept-round-wire CAD silhouette. No dimensions, wire size or performance are specified.

svg.title: Spring B — three-turn wire boundary
svg.desc: Generic open-ended projected compression helix with 3 illustrative turns. A constant-width projected wire boundary with near-over-far crossing order; it is not an exact swept-round-wire CAD silhouette. No dimensions, wire size or performance are specified.

svg.title: Spring C — four-turn centerline
svg.desc: Generic open-ended projected compression helix with 4 illustrative turns. A single centerline with near-over-far crossing gaps; wire thickness is not represented. No dimensions, wire size or performance are specified.

svg.text: A: continuous rope path; upper wheel rim omitted under the rope. Diagrammatic view.
B: near flange masks the wrap. C: shallow oblique projection with partially hidden rope.
The editable groove section is supplied separately as a supporting detail.
A: wider four-turn projected wire. B: three turns improve spacing at small sizes.
C: single-stroke centerline of A; clearer at 64 px, without wire-thickness boundaries.
Saved drawings are illustrative. Spring wire boundaries are projected approximations.
35 MM FRAMES SHOWN AT PRINT SIZE / 64 PX RENDERS PROVIDED SEPARATELY
UNITS AND PHYSICAL PROPORTIONS ARE NOT MANUFACTURING SPECIFICATIONS

svg.desc: Schematic section of a rope seated in a sheave groove. Hatching is confined to the cut wheel material. This local detail does not replace the face-view pulley icon and is not a dimensioned or manufacturer-specific section.

svg.title: Compression spring — projected wire centerline
svg.desc: A simplified projected continuous helical wire centerline, with occlusion gaps at crossings. Wire thickness is unspecified. Turn count, open ends, handedness, material and geometry are illustrative, not design specifications.

svg.title: MECHANICAL AND STRUCTURAL
svg.desc: DRAWING TYPES IDENTIFIED WITH EACH ITEM
svg.text: DRAWING TYPES IDENTIFIED WITH EACH ITEM

svg.title: Bolt
svg.desc: A hex-head bolt in side elevation with a conventional thread indication. The thread, head standard, length and fastening condition are not specified.

svg.title: Foot-mounted motor
svg.desc: Proposed generic parallel oblique exterior: cylindrical housing, three longitudinal surface ridges, mounting foot and one coaxial output shaft. Motor technology, power and motion are not specified.

svg.title: Linear actuator — proposed drafting variant
svg.desc: A generic axial linear-actuator body and extending output rod; its single rear face mark and two longitudinal marks remain. Power source, control, stroke and force are unspecified.

svg.title: Piston and rod
svg.desc: A piston head with ring grooves connects to a rod. This proposed flat view omits an unexplained circular mark present in candidate 03; the rod joint remains unspecified.

svg.title: Cylinder and piston — section
svg.desc: A cutaway actuator cylinder contains a piston and rod. Hatching indicates a section only; seals, ports, fluid and operation are not specified.

svg.title: Servo actuator — proposed drafting variant
svg.desc: Generic rotary servo-style box with a top output boss and horn, with two endpoint marks. A housing and horn do not establish feedback, position, accuracy or a specific product.

svg.title: Beam
svg.desc: A straight beam rests on two simple supports. Support restraint, loading, cross-section and deflection are unspecified.

svg.title: Frame
svg.desc: A portal-shaped frame has two columns and a connected cross-member. Joint rigidity, stability and material are not determined.

svg.title: Support
svg.desc: A triangular support carries a pinned contact over a base. The rendering does not fully define constraint freedoms or a standardized support symbol.

svg.title: Bracket
svg.desc: An L-shaped bracket has holes on its two legs. This simplified outline specifies no mounting hardware, geometry or load capacity.

svg.title: Foundation
svg.desc: A column meets a hatched footing on a ground line. A conceptual section only; soil, reinforcement and anchorage are not specified.

svg.title: Cut
svg.desc: A saw blade meets the top surface of a workpiece. The local depiction does not specify cut depth, process parameters or safety conditions.

svg.title: MECHANICAL AND STRUCTURAL
svg.desc: DRAWING TYPES IDENTIFIED WITH EACH ITEM
svg.text: DRAWING TYPES IDENTIFIED WITH EACH ITEM

svg.title: Weld
svg.desc: A welding torch points to a fillet at the junction of two plates. No weld symbol, procedure, material, joint quality or completed weld is established.

svg.title: Drill
svg.desc: A pointed twist drill touches the upper face of a workpiece. The shape indicates a process, not a specified hole or cutting condition.

svg.title: Mill
svg.desc: A flat-ended multi-flute milling cutter meets a workpiece. Tool motion, cutter material and resulting surface are not specified.

svg.title: Bend
svg.desc: A press punch forms a sheet into a V-shaped die. Angle, bend radius, material and springback are unspecified.

svg.title: Cast
svg.desc: A crucible pours into an open mold cavity. This generic casting scene does not define alloy, mold construction or process conditions.

svg.title: Machine — turning
svg.desc: A single-point tool contacts a cylindrical workpiece in a turning setup. Rotation, feed, material, chuck and machining tolerances are unspecified.

svg.title: Exploded view
svg.desc: Three separated sleeves appear in longitudinal section along a shared assembly axis. Only their order and proposed alignment are depicted; fasteners and actual fit are unspecified.

svg.title: Mating
svg.desc: A shaft is seated within a surrounding socket in a sectional representation. Contact is schematic; clearance, retention and compatibility are not specified.

svg.title: Insertion

svg.title: Alignment
svg.desc: Two separated shaft sections share a patterned axis. A shared drawn axis is an alignment cue, not a tolerance or metrology result.

svg.title: Attachment

svg.title: Rotation
svg.desc: A disc with a curved arrow indicates rotation about its center. Direction is an example, not measured motion.

svg.title: Translation
svg.desc: A block and parallel arrows indicate translation along a straight path. The two arrows illustrate a direction at a position, not speed or displacement.

svg.title: Oscillation
svg.desc: A pivoted arm with two arrowheads indicates alternating angular motion. Amplitude, frequency and driver are unspecified.

svg.title: Reciprocation
svg.desc: A slider with opposing straight arrows indicates repeated back-and-forth translation. Stroke, period and actual movement are unspecified.

svg.title: Gear pair — abstract
svg.desc: Two touching pitch circles indicate a conceptual pair of gears. Local shorthand; no tooth geometry, standard compliance or transmission ratio is asserted.

svg.title: Force
svg.desc: A force vector points to a body at its illustrated application point. Magnitude, units, load case and resulting motion are unspecified.

svg.title: Torque
svg.desc: A curved arrow around a shaft face indicates a torque; plus is counterclockwise as viewed. Illustrative sign choice; torque is a moment, and magnitude, axis convention and rotation are unspecified.

svg.title: Tension
svg.desc: Equal-looking arrows pull outward from opposite ends of a member. The sketch does not quantify stress, equilibrium or material response.

svg.title: Compression
svg.desc: Arrows push inward on opposite ends of a member. The sketch does not quantify stress, buckling or material response.

svg.title: Shear
svg.desc: Opposed tangential arrows act on parallel faces of a block. This depicts a loading idea, not a complete stress state or equilibrium analysis.

svg.title: Moment of force
svg.desc: A rightward moment arm and upward force illustrate a counterclockwise positive moment about the pivot. The sign convention is local to this view; no force, length or calculated moment is given. Torque is also a moment.

svg.title: Variable

svg.title: Constant
svg.desc: A c with a zero derivative with respect to t illustrates a constant in t. A generic notation example; no model, numerical value or result is asserted.

svg.title: Parameter
svg.desc: Theta in a function subscript illustrates a parameter. A generic notation example; no model, numerical value or result is asserted.

svg.title: Function
svg.desc: The expression f of x illustrates a function. A generic notation example; no model, numerical value or result is asserted.

svg.title: Operators
svg.desc: An addition operator combines two symbolic quantities. A generic notation example; no model, numerical value or result is asserted.

svg.title: Summation
svg.desc: A summation sign represents adding terms over an index. A generic notation example; no model, numerical value or result is asserted.

svg.title: Integration
svg.desc: An integral sign and differential represent continuous integration. A generic notation example; no model, numerical value or result is asserted.

svg.title: Vector
svg.desc: An arrow over v represents a vector. A generic notation example; no model, numerical value or result is asserted.

svg.title: Matrix
svg.desc: A two-by-two symbolic matrix illustrates a matrix. A generic notation example; no model, numerical value or result is asserted.

svg.title: Coordinate reference frame
svg.desc: Three labeled axes illustrate a coordinate reference frame. A generic notation example; no model, numerical value or result is asserted.

svg.title: Probability distribution

svg.title: SCIENTIFIC AND MATHEMATICAL
svg.desc: DRAWING TYPES IDENTIFIED WITH EACH ITEM
svg.text: DRAWING TYPES IDENTIFIED WITH EACH ITEM

svg.title: Statistical uncertainty — standard error
svg.desc: A sample mean plus or minus its estimated standard error, s divided by the square root of n. A generic notation example; no model, numerical value or result is asserted. For independent identically distributed observations with finite variance, s is the sample standard deviation and n is the number of observations greater than one. This does not specify a confidence interval or nonstatistical uncertainty.

svg.title: Measurement
svg.desc: A symbolic length measurement, with an unknown numerical value in metres. A generic notation example; no model, numerical value or result is asserted. The question mark is a placeholder, not a reading.

svg.title: Calibration
svg.desc: Illustrative observed readings versus reference values on a calibration graph. A generic notation example; no model, numerical value or result is asserted. The plotted positions are illustrative, not calibration data or a fitted result.

svg.title: Optimization
svg.desc: Minimizing f of x illustrates an optimization objective. A generic notation example; no model, numerical value or result is asserted. The feasible set, optimizer and result are unspecified.

svg.title: Convergence
svg.desc: A sequence x sub n approaching x star illustrates convergence. A generic notation example; no model, numerical value or result is asserted. No convergence criterion, sequence or limiting value is specified.

svg.title: Waveform
svg.desc: A generic continuous periodic waveform against time. A generic notation example; no model, numerical value or result is asserted. Amplitude, period and units are unspecified.

svg.title: Frequency
svg.desc: Frequency f is the reciprocal of period T. A generic notation example; no model, numerical value or result is asserted. This identity applies to a periodic signal.

svg.title: Sampling
svg.desc: Discrete sample points on a continuous waveform. A generic notation example; no model, numerical value or result is asserted. Points indicate a concept, not an observed signal or prescribed sampling rate.

svg.title: Discretization
svg.desc: A staircase function illustrates a piecewise constant discretization. A generic notation example; no model, numerical value or result is asserted. Step positions and heights are illustrative and do not imply a numerical method.

svg.title: Units
svg.desc: Metres per second illustrates a coherent SI derived unit. A generic notation example; no model, numerical value or result is asserted. It denotes a unit, not an observed speed.

svg.title: Dimensional analysis
svg.desc: The dimension of speed is length divided by time. A generic notation example; no model, numerical value or result is asserted. L and T denote dimensions, not unit symbols.

svg.desc: A triangular attachment connects a boxed synthetic datum letter A to a surface. Generic candidate only; it does not define a datum reference frame or establish GD&T compliance.

svg.title: DRAWING AND DOCUMENT SYMBOLS
svg.desc: DRAWING TYPES IDENTIFIED WITH EACH ITEM
svg.text: DRAWING TYPES IDENTIFIED WITH EACH ITEM

svg.title: Dimension
svg.desc: Extension and dimension lines span a part feature with symbolic length L. L has no value or units; the mark is not a manufacturing dimension.

svg.title: Revision marker
svg.desc: A triangular revision marker with synthetic letter A points to an illustrative changed feature. The marker is not an approval, a revision record or proof of a change.

svg.title: Reference leader
svg.desc: A leader terminates on a particular feature of a part. The leader has no attached instruction; its intended reference must be supplied in a drawing.

svg.title: Coordinate grid
svg.desc: A two-axis grid uses X and Y to indicate coordinate directions. Grid spacing, origin, datum and units are not specified.

svg.title: Note
svg.desc: A numbered example note reads DEBURR with two supporting text lines. The text is synthetic and does not impose a manufacturing instruction.

svg.title: Footnote
svg.desc: A superscript 1 on A matches the numbered footnote reference below. The example contains no substantive note and is not a formal drafting requirement.

svg.title: Tolerance placeholder
svg.desc: The expression L ± t shows an illustrative nominal quantity and symmetric tolerance. L and t are unbound variables; no numeric limits, units or geometric tolerance are specified.

svg.title: Scale indicator
svg.desc: The ratio 1:n is a symbolic view-scale indicator. n is unspecified; no actual view scale or calibrated bar is claimed.
